figures.name: Apedemak

ability.name: Lion God's Roar
ability.description: Deal 7 damage to all enemies; warrior allies gain +3 power for 1 turn.

figures.description: The great lion-headed warrior god of Kush who supplanted Amun as the supreme deity of Meroe.

figures.name: Amesemi

ability.name: Hawk's Shield
ability.description: Negate all attacks against one ally for 1 turn; grant that ally +2 to all stats.

figures.description: Protective hawk goddess and divine counterpart of Apedemak who guarded the Kushite warrior kings.

figures.name: Arensnuphis

ability.name: Nubian Companion
ability.description: Grant one ally +3 to all stats for 1 turn from divine companionship.

figures.description: Nubian deity who stood as divine companion to the Egyptian gods, particularly Isis, at Philae.

figures.name: Sebiumeker

ability.name: Meroitic Creation
ability.description: When played, all allies gain +2 magic for 2 turns.

figures.description: Supreme creator god of the Meroitic civilization at Meroe whose prominence rivaled all imported Egyptian deities.

figures.name: Kandake

ability.name: Iron Queen
ability.description: Deal 5 damage; all enemies' attack on this card is reduced by 2 — they fear the queen.

figures.description: The legendary warrior queens of Kush who led armies and commanded divine authority in battle.

figures.name: Dedwen

ability.name: Sacred Incense
ability.description: Remove all curses from all allies; enemies' special abilities cost 1 more to activate.

figures.description: Nubian fire and incense god who presided over the great wealth of southern trade goods prized by Egypt.

figures.name: Mandulis

ability.name: Nubian Dawn
ability.description: Grant all allies +2 power at the start of each turn for 2 turns.

figures.description: The young solar god of Lower Nubia whose devotion required daily ritual purification at sunrise.

figures.name: Atoum (Nubian)

ability.name: Setting Sun
ability.description: This card's power increases by 1 each turn to a maximum of +4.

figures.description: The Nubian form of the completed sun god Atum, worshipped as the evening sun descending into the underworld.

figures.name: Piankhi

ability.name: Conqueror's Decree
ability.description: All enemies with higher power than this card lose 2 of that power from divine humbling.

figures.description: The Kushite pharaoh who conquered all Egypt, worshipped Egyptian gods more devoutly than the Egyptians.

figures.name: Natakamani

ability.name: Builder's Legacy
ability.description: When this card is in play, all structure or defense abilities cost 1 less.

figures.description: The great builder king of Meroe whose temples and pyramids still stand in the Sudanese desert.

figures.name: Meroitic Lion

ability.name: Sacred Mane
ability.description: Grant one warrior ally +4 power for 1 turn from the lion spirit.

figures.description: The sacred lions of Meroe who stood in temple precincts and were intimately associated with Apedemak.

figures.name: Nile Serpent

ability.name: River God
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to all water and earth allies per turn for 2 turns.

figures.description: The divine serpent spirit of the Nile whose annual flood brought life to the parched Nubian earth.

figures.name: Arikankharer

ability.name: War Elephant
ability.description: Deal 6 damage to one enemy; push all adjacent enemies back one row.

figures.description: Kushite warrior prince who fought the Romans alongside war elephants in the campaigns of the Kandake.

figures.name: Pyramid Ghost

ability.name: Pyramid Curse
ability.description: Inflict a pyramid curse: enemy loses 2 HP per turn for 2 turns from the ancient warning.

figures.description: The guardian spirit of the royal Meroitic pyramid tombs who punishes those who disturb the sacred dead.

figures.name: Thueris (Nubian)

ability.name: Hippo Mother
ability.description: Absorb 3 damage for any ally; restore 2 HP to that ally.

figures.description: The Nubian hippo goddess of protection in childbirth, fearsome to enemies but gentle to mothers.

figures.name: Reshef (Nubian)

ability.name: Plague Arrow
ability.description: Deal 4 damage and inflict plague on one enemy: -1 HP per turn for 2 turns.

figures.description: The Semitic war and plague god adopted into Nubian worship along the Nile trade routes.

figures.name: Kushite Archer

ability.name: Nubian Bowman
ability.description: Deal 5 ranged damage ignoring ground defenses; hit from any row.

figures.description: The legendary Kushite archer whose extraordinary skill made Nubian bowmen the most feared in the ancient world.

figures.name: Meroitic Sphinx

ability.name: Sphinx Guard
ability.description: All direct attacks against allies in the back row are blocked for 1 turn.

figures.description: The distinctive ram-headed Meroitic sphinx that guarded temple avenues and embodied royal divine power.

figures.name: Shablul

ability.name: Funerary Worker
ability.description: Perform one ally's task instead of them for 1 turn; grant that ally 2 HP.

figures.description: Funerary figure placed in Kushite tombs to perform labor on behalf of the dead in the afterlife.

figures.name: Wepwawet (Nubian)

ability.name: Path Opener
ability.description: The first ability your side uses each turn costs 0 energy.

figures.description: Wolf-headed opener of the ways who led armies into battle and opened the path to the afterlife.
